text.title: Blurred Roles and Team Evolution Failure Modes
text.summary: 9 antipatterns observed across deployments, including the agent gotchas of overlapping-role zones. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: PM and design lead both produce conflicting specs; eng ships the loudest.
antipattern.root-cause: No DRI assigned to the PM∩Design overlap zone.
antipattern.fix: Assign a single DRI per Venn zone; agents may participate but never own the decision.

antipattern.symptom: PMs expected to give design feedback; designers not expected to track metrics; designers resent the blur.
antipattern.root-cause: One-sided blurring is extractive; expectations were never paired.
antipattern.fix: Pair every cross-expectation symmetrically; document in the role-evolution doc.

antipattern.symptom: No depth specialist in security; quarterly audit surfaces 12 critical gaps.
antipattern.root-cause: Team blurred security across all engineers; nobody owned depth.
antipattern.fix: Retain at least one depth specialist per deep domain (security, ML eval, a11y); blur the periphery only.

antipattern.symptom: Team hires 2 PMs per engineer because of Ng 2024 talk; engineers report being micromanaged.
antipattern.root-cause: Treated ratio as a universal target rather than per-team hypothesis.
antipattern.fix: Measure agent-assisted velocity per team; tune ratio per measured throughput, not slideware.

antipattern.symptom: Blurred roles defined in a Notion page but not reflected in actual work assignment or code ownership.
antipattern.root-cause: Blurred roles drift back to silos under deadline pressure. The quarterly audit is the forcing function that prevents reversion.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule quarterly-audit-by-git-shortlog; compare the role doc against templates/role-overlap.sh output every quarter.

antipattern.symptom: Running four role-persona agents without a human DRI convergence step.
antipattern.root-cause: The loudest or first agent's recommendation ships. Convergence is the mechanism that turns parallel lenses into a decision.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule one-agent-role-per-zone-human-converges; attach a converge step with a named DRI to every diverge run.

antipattern.symptom: PM-agent given an engineering codebase with no tool constraints.
antipattern.root-cause: Agents inherit the prompt's role boundary but not skill limits. Constrain via tool allow-lists per persona, not prose instructions alone.
antipattern.fix: Define a tool allow-list per persona before the run.

antipattern.symptom: Using agent-driven skill assessments ("rate this PM on data fluency from their PRDs") as performance inputs.
antipattern.root-cause: Assessments are noisy and biased toward verbose writers. Use as discussion seeds only; never as performance evidence.
antipattern.fix: Label every agent assessment as a discussion seed; keep it out of performance files.

antipattern.symptom: Cross-role knowledge transfer between agents without a PII filter.
antipattern.root-cause: The data-agent may surface customer PII in a design-agent prompt. Run a scrubber filter on inter-agent handoffs that cross role boundaries.
antipattern.fix: Insert a scrubber step on every inter-agent handoff that crosses a role boundary.

list.item: DRI assignment per overlap zone — documented in the role doc, not tribal knowledge
Approval of any role-restructure SDD task generated by the audit agent
Final sign-off on hiring scorecards produced by agents
